decision_cruda.rationale: C564-14 holds 138 t at 12.1 g/t, about 53.7 oz. LH-01 is down, with repair estimates of 12:20 (low), 13:20 (likely) and 14:20 (high). Once repaired, LH514 loads 40.8 t/h, so by 17:00 it can clear the 138 t in the low and likely cases (3.7 h x 40.8 = 150 t). In the high case it clears about 109 t, so a loan would add about 11 oz. The only nearby lender is LH-09 from DS-C564-02, 0.34 h away. It costs 1.5 oz per hour away, about 5-6 oz until the likely repair. The expected gain is about 0.25 x 11 = 3 oz, which is less than the cost. LH-08 is 0.71 h away and slower to arrive. The other stopes are all producing and have no spare loader. The reserves need a stopped stope, and none is stopped. No loans.
